comment: Dr. Gupton is the best man alive. Organic chemistry is still very difficult and a lot of work, but once you get the hang of how his quizzes and tests work it becomes much easier. He is very straightforward. You must know your material inside and out but Dr. Gupton really wants people to like chemistry. I highly recommend him.
One of the best teachers Ive ever had super consistent and wants you to do well.

I loved this class! Came into this class nervous about Organic Chem but left much more confident in my chemistry abilities. The test and quizzes were straightforward and so long as you study you should do fine. Dr. Gupton was a joy to have as a professor and I would definitely recommend him to anyone.

He's pretty straight forward, study the notes and that is what is going to be on the test, or some variation of it. Have taken him for 205 and 206 and it is a time consuming course but not impossible. He gives you the lecture and its your job to study and catch everything he says in class which is probably the hardest part.

Seemed like an alright class until I realized that you have to copy notes very fast as he puts them up on a projector screen and takes them down very quickly while not putting them online either.  Did not seem like a helpful professor and got very boring and repetitive.  He actually seemed to get angry at the class sometimes.  Do not recommend.

Dr. Gupton is an experienced teacher, who is very clear in his expectations, which are high. He gives weekly quizzes, which have no tricks to them. His tests are essentially long quizzes. He moves VERY quickly, and does not publish his notes, which might be his only disadvantage. Cares about students, especially chemistry majors. Very helpful.

He's a really cool guy, and seems to enjoy teaching. Quizzes are helpful for making you look at the material, but can be a pain if you have other tests on fridays. Don't bother buying the book, as literally everything you need to know comes from notes and handouts.

I barely passed Orgo 1, but switched to Dr. Gupton for Orgo 2 and actually ended up enjoying the class!  He explains things very well and the quizes each week were so helpful in staying on top of the material.  Test questions were always straightforward.  He was a little monotone, but overall a great teacher!

Gupton is a sweetheart, very nice.  May be intimidating at first.  Great teacher though boring at times.  Quizzes every week but straight from the notes.  Not that hard (considering it IS organic chem) as long as you put in the work.  He really wants everyone to do well.
very very tough professor.  he's a little bit intimidating, but he is nice and does want you to succeed.  be prepared to work very very hard just to pass.

gupton's tests and quizzes are almost straight from notes and he doesnt throw any curve balls at ya. theres a quiz every wk but it helps when it comes time for tests. easy class if u follow and understand lecture and notes.
Excellent teacher! Very helpful and enthusiastic about material!
you do have to put int he effort, but he makes it worthwhile.  very helpful both in and out of class.  he makes organic make sense.

Real clear... good at explaining difficult concepts. Quizzes are ok. Tests are impossible! Does not allow makeup exams...even if your sick and on ur death bed. Not flexible and not forgiving. Can be helpful outside of class. Allows extra credit by attending chemistry seminars...max of 4 for 5 points each. Overall ok. Be prepared to work ur ass off!
Watch out for the final (he makes his own).  It is worth a lot and it will destroy your average (even a solid A) if you mess it up.
Really enjoyed having him as a professor.  Not terribly difficult to get good grades if you study because he puts in the effort to make sure the material is properly explained
Best chemistry teacher in the department.  Great notes, helpful outside of class, tests are never a surprise.  If you study, and study hard/keep up, there's no way to get lower than a B.
Good, helpful guy, gives very explicit notes, makes ochem not scary
No Comments
Awesome teacher, very helpful and explains things very well.  Would recommend to anyone
